metadata.policy_status: Draft diagnostic cut points; process-owner review required

constraints.description: More than one recorded initial outpatient consultation prompts review of episode boundaries and referral duplication.
High telephone-contact volume prompts review of coordination burden, while retaining useful patient communication.
A long follow-up sequence identifies a complex pathway for review; planned surveillance is a legitimate explanation.
Review the first observed outpatient-to-follow-up interval. This interval may be a planned clinical schedule rather than waiting.

datasets.business_goal: Reduce avoidable coordination waiting while retaining indicated care.

steps: Link diagnosis-treatment phases in reviewed cases.
Classify high-contact records as planned support, missing information, duplicated routing or scheduling uncertainty.
If avoidable coordination is confirmed, trial one named contact and an agreed follow-up ownership record.
improvement.comparison: Compare a declared comparable cohort or phased rollout with the pre-trial baseline. Retain whole-case context and required work.
outcomes: Verified scheduling waiting
Unanswered coordination requests
Clinical follow-up and patient access
improvement.decision_gate: A recurring avoidable mechanism must be confirmed by case and source-record review before the change is trialled.
improvement.stop_condition: Revise the trial if protected care, legal rights, access or correct financial handling deteriorates.
improvement.status: Conditional process-improvement proposal; no trial or outcome is asserted.

interpretation: No staff resource identifiers are present in the local profile; org:group names a group, not an individual.
Repeated consultations, tests and radiotherapy are not treatment failures.

The proposed follow-up range is descriptive and needs pathway-specific interpretation.

constraints.description: An aborted payment attempt prompts inspection of the complete payment cycle and the eventual valid outcome.
Decision revocation prompts review of correction reasons and legal-objection context.
Repeated initial-application decisions prompt review of document versions and corrections; they are not presumed improper.
Repeated editing starts identify applications with potential coordination burden or recording complexity.
A payment start in the Change subprocess identifies a revised-payment case for review of avoidable correction causes.
A payment start in the Objection subprocess identifies a case requiring review while preserving the right to object.

datasets.business_goal: Begin valid initial payments by the funding-year target while preserving required inspections and objection rights.

steps: Establish the surviving valid payment cycle for reviewed abort cases.
Separate inspection dependencies, reference-data gaps, justified objections and avoidable internal handoffs.
If readiness gaps are confirmed, trial a cross-document readiness check and one exception owner.
improvement.comparison: Compare a declared comparable cohort or phased rollout with the pre-trial baseline. Retain whole-case context and required work.
outcomes: Valid initial payment starts by year-end
Confirmed avoidable aborts
Required inspection, entitlement and objection handling
improvement.decision_gate: A recurring avoidable mechanism must be confirmed by case and source-record review before the change is trialled.
improvement.stop_condition: Revise the trial if protected care, legal rights, access or correct financial handling deteriorates.
improvement.status: Conditional process-improvement proposal; no trial or outcome is asserted.

interpretation: Qualified classifier is doctype|subprocess|activity; keep original concept:name, docid, docid_uuid and event identity as evidence.
All listed qualified activities were observed in the first 500 local application traces.
The primary target of timely valid payment is separate from the executable diagnostic count baseline.
Generic first decide-to-finish-payment pairing can cross documents or cycles and is not used in this baseline.
Applied amounts, received amounts and area are binned for anonymization; they are not exact balancing evidence.
Funding-year and department comparisons must account for the documented parcel-document replacements across years.
Reopened payment, financial penalties and legal objections are outcomes to investigate; none alone establishes an administrative error.

Observation coverage through the funding-year end
pending_checks.severity: Binary review flag for no surviving initial payment start by year-end in the eligible, sufficiently observed cohort. Rejected and withdrawn applications require separately approved applicability.
pending_checks.reason: Native Lag has no calendar deadline or cancellation-aware cycle matching; generic occurrence counts cannot establish this target.
